children: America's Car-Mart entered into a further extension of its Amendment and Limited Waiver under its senior secured Credit and Guaranty Agreement with Silver Point Finance and participating lenders. The Third Extension pushes the waiver period and Scheduled Termination Date to September 24, 2026, and continues temporary relief from certain minimum liquidity and collateral coverage requirements. The company said it is making progress on strategic alternatives while working with the agent and lenders.
: Amendment and limited waiver to senior secured credit agreement (Third Extension)
: Silver Point Finance, as Administrative Agent, and other lenders
: Provide temporary covenant relief during strategic review
